label: POC Onboarding: Status
mcp_tool_description: Report what the appliance has configured for a proof of concept in one call: licence, portal URL, SMTP, proxy, Content Library reachability, Setup Wizard step states, every resource handler with its environments (OS builds, networks, groups, lifecycle parameters, last verify result), the Custom Server blueprint and its orders, servers left in Provision Failed state, groups and users, LDAP and SSO, which onboarding tools are installed and synchronous, the POC items recorded as done or not applicable, and nextSteps with a UI link for each. Call it at the start of every onboarding phase and after any change, before deciding what to do next. Read-only; requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
